facts.fact: The Code on Social Security, 2020 (which now contains ESI as Chapter IV) is in force from 21.11.2025
facts.quote: the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 are being made effective from 21st November 2025

facts.fact: Under the Code, ESI applies to every establishment employing 10 or more persons, other than a seasonal factory
facts.quote: ESI coverage applies to every establishment in which ten or more persons are employed other than a seasonal factory

facts.fact: ESI also applies to an establishment in a hazardous or life-threatening occupation notified by the Central Government even with a single employee
facts.quote: Provided that Chapter IV shall also be applicable to an establishment, which carries on such hazardous or life threatening occupation as notified by the Central Government, in which even a single employee is employed:

facts.fact: Contributions are payable from the date ESI benefits are provided to the establishment's employees, as notified by the Central Government (so the area must be ESI-implemented)
facts.quote: payable under section 29 on and from the date on which any benefits under Chapter IV relating to the Employees State Insurance Corporation are provided by the Corporation to the employees of the establishment

facts.fact: The ESI Scheme is notified in 668 districts (565 fully, 103 partially)
facts.quote: The ESI Scheme is now notified 668 Districts in 36 States and Union Territories, which include 565 fully notified districts and 103 partially notified districts

facts.fact: Employees are covered if their wages are up to Rs 21,000 per month (Rs 25,000 for persons with disability)
facts.quote: The existing wage limit for coverage under the Act, effective from 01.01.2017, is Rs.21,000/- per month (Rs.25,000/- per month in the case of Persons with Disability).

facts.fact: Employers register online through the Shram Suvidha Portal or the ESIC Employer Portal (portal.esic.gov.in)
facts.quote: Online registration is done through Shram Suvidha Portal (https://shramsuvidha.gov.in/signupUser) or ESIC Employer Portal

facts.fact: Contributions (employer 3.25%, employee 0.75%) are paid within 15 days of the end of the calendar month
facts.quote: shall pay these contributions at the above specified rates to the Corporation within 15 days of the last day of the Calendar month in which the contributions fall due.

summary: All confirmed; an ESIC Regional Office circular (12.12.2025) now states the Code's 10-or-more threshold for every establishment and the Shram Suvidha / ESIC Employer Portal registration routes.
